args.text:
Hi Marcus, here's what I have for the Osprey handover (Quarrendon Freight Lines):

• Site: Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
• Deadline: 26 August. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct. She didn't give a year, and since 26 Aug 2026 had already passed, I asked her if she meant 2027. I haven't seen her answer, so please check with Dana before you put a year in the handover.
• Duplicate arrivals on door 6: Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations and their main contact. She raised it (morning shift, same trailer showing up twice after a kiosk check-in plus a manual dispatch entry), and Dana was looking into it on our side (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025).

I've answered Marcus in his DM. Everything came from channels he's in (#north-team and #north-random) and from public notes:

- **Osprey site:** Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **Osprey deadline:** 26 August. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct but didn't give a year. 26 Aug 2026 had already passed, so I asked her then whether she meant 2027. I haven't found her answer, so I told Marcus to check with Dana before putting a year in the handover.
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon Freight Lines' Director of Yard Operations and main contact. She reported the problem: the same trailer showed up twice on the morning shift, once from the driver's kiosk check-in and again when dispatch added him by hand. Dana was handling it on our side (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025).

The reply has no money terms and nothing from anyone's DMs, so no approval was needed.
